title: Leslie Liao | Silky Smooth (Full Comedy Special)
description:
In her debut hour special, Leslie Liao explores the chaotic stages of adulthood, scheduling fun plans with tired friends, the unfair treatment of single people, being attracted to silly men, and the fear of being a role model to her pretend children. Leslie presents life’s bold truths with precision that will make you think of her comedy in the most vulnerable moments of your nighttime routine.

If you enjoyed the show, don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more stand-up content.
